suggestions.reason: The accessibility tree shows a single tab with the accessible name "Personal Loan" (singular) inside the "Loan type" tablist, so the original locator only failed because of the trailing "s".

Fallback if the role is ever dropped: the exact string "Personal Loan" appears only on that tab (the glance panel shows "Home Loan" and the intro paragraph uses lowercase "personal"), though the role-based locator is stronger because the element does have a role.
